title: Armenian Style Lentil Soup
description: A hearty soup with lentils, mint, and parsley — a Shehirian family classic.
steps: Boil lentils in water for 15 minutes.
Add onion, parsley, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 45 minutes.
Add mint and butter. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add 1/4 tsp. pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Optional: Fry butter until light brown and pour over soup.

title: Royal Soup
description: A lemony meatball soup with rice and parsley, inspired by Middle Eastern flavors.
steps: Mix raw meat, bulghur wheat, onion, parsley and seasoning together and shape into 1" diameter balls.
Add rice to the meat balls mixture.
Add meat balls to hot chicken broth and simmer until cooked through.
Add lemon juice and celery. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add salt and lemon slices. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Adjust sourness, saltiness, or thickness with sugar, water, or rice as needed.
Pour broth over meatballs and serve.

title: Scotch Broth
description: A traditional Scottish soup made with lamb, root vegetables, and barley — warm and filling.
steps: Simmer lamb in stock for 1 hour, skimming off any foam.
Add barley and cook for 30 minutes.
Add chopped vegetables and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes.
Remove lamb, shred meat, and return to pot.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

title: Kibbeh Labanieh
description: Traditional kibbeh cooked in creamy yogurt sauce - a Lebanese favorite.
steps: Soak bulgur in water for 10 minutes, then drain well.
Mix ground meat, bulgur, half the onion, salt, pepper, and allspice. Knead well.
Shape mixture into small oval balls.
Whisk yogurt with cornstarch until smooth.
Bring yogurt mixture to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add kibbeh balls and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a pan, sauté garlic, remaining onion, and mint in butter.
Pour garlic mixture over kibbeh and serve with rice.

title: Fattoush Salad
description: Fresh Middle Eastern salad with crispy pita chips and sumac dressing.
steps: Toast pita bread until crispy, then break into bite-sized pieces.
Combine all vegetables and herbs in a large bowl.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, sumac, and salt.
Add pita chips just before serving.
Toss with dressing and serve immediately.

title: Mjadara
description: Lentils and rice with caramelized onions - comfort food at its finest.
steps: Rinse lentils and cook in 3 cups water for 15 minutes.
Add rice, cumin, salt, and remaining water. Cook until tender.
Meanwhile, fry onions in olive oil until golden brown and crispy.
Reserve half the onions for garnish.
Mix remaining onions into the lentil-rice mixture.
Top with reserved crispy onions and serve with yogurt.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves (Warak Enab)
description: Tender grape leaves filled with rice, herbs, and spices.
steps: Rinse grape leaves and remove stems.
Mix rice, meat (if using), tomato, herbs, and spices.
Place a spoonful of filling on each leaf and roll tightly.
Layer rolls in a pot, seam side down.
Add lemon juice, oil, and water to cover.
Place a plate on top to keep rolls in place.
Simmer for 45 minutes until rice is cooked.
Serve warm or cold with yogurt.

title: Baba Ganoush
description: Smoky eggplant dip with tahini, garlic, and lemon.
steps: Roast eggplants over open flame or in oven at 450°F until skin is charred.
Let cool, then peel off skin and remove seeds.
Mash eggplant flesh with a fork.
Mix in tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and salt.
Blend until smooth or leave slightly chunky.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Garnish with parsley and serve with pita bread.

title: Tabbouleh
description: Fresh parsley salad with bulgur, tomatoes, and lemon dressing.
steps: Soak bulgur in water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
Finely chop all vegetables and herbs.
Mix parsley, bulgur, tomatoes, mint, and onions.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and allspice.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.
Serve with romaine lettuce leaves as scoops.

title: Chicken Shawarma
description: Marinated chicken with Middle Eastern spices, perfect for wraps.
ingredients: Pita bread and tahini sauce for serving
steps: Mix all spices with oil, lemon juice, and garlic to make marinade.
Add chicken and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Serve in pita bread with tomatoes, onions, and tahini sauce.

title: Hummus with Spiced Meat
description: Creamy hummus topped with seasoned ground meat and pine nuts.
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth.
Add water if needed for desired consistency.
Season with salt and spread on a serving plate.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan until golden.
Brown meat with remaining oil, allspice, and cinnamon.
Spoon meat mixture over hummus.
Top with pine nuts and serve with warm pita.

title: Shish Tawook
description: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in yogurt and lemon.
steps: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, tomato paste, and spices.
Add chicken cubes and coat well with marinade.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Thread chicken onto soaked wooden skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve with garlic sauce, pickles, and pita bread.

title: Knafeh
description: Sweet cheese pastry with crispy shredded phyllo and syrup.
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mozzarella or akkawi cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix shredded phyllo with melted butter.
Press half the phyllo mixture into a buttered baking pan.
Layer cheese evenly over phyllo.
Top with remaining phyllo mixture and press down.
Bake for 30-40 minutes until golden and crispy.
Meanwhile, boil sugar, water, and lemon juice for 5 minutes.
Add orange blossom water to syrup.
Pour syrup over hot knafeh and top with pistachios.
